newsitem.title: INDIA: Suspected tribals kill 15 in India.
newsitem.headline: Suspected tribals kill 15 in India.

text.p: Suspected tribal militants killed at least 15 people sleeping inside a market in northeastern India on Friday, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
The suspected guerrillas fired on people early in the morning in the market in Kalyanpur town in Tripura state, then set houses on fire, the news agency said, quoting local officials.
PTI said senior police officials had gone to the site to investigate.
Tripura state is in India's remote northeastern region and borders Bangladesh to the west.
